description: This file contains dependency helper functions for user authentication and authorization in a FastAPI backend, including functions to resolve users from bearer tokens and enforce admin privileges.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, including roles.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enumeration for user roles, e.g., admin.

methods.name: Optional[User] _resolve_user_from_bearer( credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials], db: Session, )
methods.description: Internal helper to resolve a User object from a bearer token, handling token validation and user lookup.

methods.name: User get_current_user( credentials: Annotated[Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials], Depends(bearer_scheme)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Dependency that provides the currently authenticated user, raises 401 if invalid or missing.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_optional_user( credentials: Annotated[Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials], Depends(bearer_scheme)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Dependency that provides the current user if a valid token is present, or None otherwise.

methods.name: User require_admin(current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)])
methods.description: Enforces that the current user has admin privileges, raises 403 if not.
